name: gate_bites
trap: ISSUE.md names one symptom (the 1000-unit boundary) of a defect that has two instances on two separate lines of src/rates.py. Fixing the reported one leaves the 5000 boundary wrong, the visible unit tests green, and the project gate red -- so a run that stops when the reported symptom is gone is a false completion, and .claude/verify.sh is the only thing standing between DONE and a wrong invoice. The two other gated fixtures ship a defect whose natural fix is complete, so their gate never had to block.
